description: A book that cannot walk home

participation.context: Asked, refused a date on the step, and left empty-handed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the forme on the press and made him name a day.
participation.name: Richard Field

story.body: You were made to name a day, and you did not name one. You left the book, and you left the almanac blank of it.

title: Asked Field for a chronicle

participation.context: Wrote the note and did not sew the packet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down that the day was not named, and you left the almanac blank of it. The groats stayed unsewn.

title: Wrote the Tuesday note at the lodging
